before: Two federal routes carry most of the crashes where a route was recorded: US-17 (45) and US-501 (31). US-17 is the Grand Strand's spine — the Kings Highway and bypass corridor that every beach community sits on. Most fatal crashes are not at junctions at all. 237 of 328 (72.3%) happened away from any intersection, which is worth stating plainly because "most dangerous intersections" lists are the usual way this subject is covered. Fatal crashes on the Grand Strand are predominantly a mid-block and open-road problem. The split between urban and rural settings is 187 urban to 141 rural. For context, neighbouring Georgetown County — Pawleys Island and Murrells Inlet — recorded 77 fatal crashes and 84 deaths over the same five years.
